title: DC Animated Universe: The Films
blurb: The films that grew out of Batman: The Animated Series, from Mask of the Phantasm to a Justice League film made twenty-five years later.

dcau98.set: Between the first two Batman series

dcau00.t: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker

dcau19.t: Justice League vs. the Fatal Five

note: Return of the Joker jumps decades ahead to the Batman Beyond era, so in story order it comes last, after the much later Fatal Five. Each film works on its own, but they land harder alongside the TV series they belong to.
